prompt_template:
@style
The real exam has two kinds of item, and the set must have both:
- Situational judgment items: a realistic workplace scenario of two to five sentences, all in the stem, ending with a question that asks for the best or most effective action; every option is a plausible course of action, and only the most effective one is correct.
- Knowledge items: a direct question on HR knowledge, or on a key concept of a behavioral competency, with one correct answer.
Write about four in five of the questions under the Leadership Cluster, Interpersonal Cluster and Business Cluster as situational judgment items and the rest as knowledge items; write every question under the People, Organization and Workplace Knowledge Domains as a knowledge item. On the real exam one scenario can carry two or three questions; here each question stands alone with its own complete scenario.
Write at the level of the SHRM-CP, which SHRM sets for HR professionals in operational roles.
Keep each stem concrete and free of trick wording. Do not refer to other questions, images, tables or exhibits.
